name: James Justice
bio: a Senator from West Virginia; born in Charleston, W.Va., April 27, 1951; graduated Woodrow Wilson High School, Beckley, W.Va., 1969; B.A., Marshall University, Huntington, W.Va., 1974; M.B.A., Marshall University, Huntington, W.Va., 1976; agriculture and coal mining businessman; company founder and chief executive officer; governor of West Virginia 2017-2025; elected as a Republican to the United States Senate in 2024 for the term ending January 3, 2031.
